en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of two children dressed in traditional Galician costumes, with ornate headwear and accessories. They are standing close to each other, gazing affectionately. The background is a studio setting, possibly meant to evoke a rustic outdoor scene. The top of the card has red printed text that reads 'SANTIAGO - Parejita gallega.' There is handwritten text near the bottom, partially legible.
